text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Thaaat's why! How many times do I gotta tell you?!
Don't just nod and agree to things without even asking what it is first!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: B-But... they looked like they were in trouble, so I just couldn't help it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems she's getting a lecture.
Most likely out of concern for Dants Flame
being far too good-natured, butâ
choice_data_list: Now, now, let's leave it at that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Being a soft touch is nothing new for them... I thought, moving to step in and stop it."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
At least pick and choose who you ask!
Who in their right mind agrees to Tachyon's experiments without a second thought?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Wah!? T-Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. Good thing I just happened to step in
and break it up, but...
Who knows what'll happen next time.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I'm so sorry...
Whenever someone asks, I just can't say no...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I don't need your thanks.
More importantly, you should teach them how to say no.
No matter how good-natured someone is—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. When it comes to being good-natured, you're also... no, in your case, should I say you're attentive and caring?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: F-Fuji-san! Thanks for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Good work... Ugh.
But... how specifically do you practice saying no?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's true...
Dants's Trainer, do you have any good ideas?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
A role model... Um, who?
I'll do my absolute best to learn from them!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
You will, Trainer?
Thank you so much...!
I'll be in your care!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we think up the setting first?
The situation is very important, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"—So that's how it is.
Could you maybe give me some special training guidance?"
choice_data_list: Because there's someone I need to prioritize.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...No matter what?
I am in serious trouble.
I have no one else... but you to turn to...
choice_data_list: N-No matter what, it's just no good.
N-No matter what, it's just no good.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Fuji-san went this far out of her way
to ask you...!
Are you really gonna turn her down?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: The hell did you just say!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
P-Please wait!
Trainer is, well, a busy person...
I'll go instead, so don't worry!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait, wait, that's not right.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Ah!
S-Sorry, this was supposed to be a demonstration, wasn't it?
Your acting was so convincing, I just reacted without thinking...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“...... Ah, oh no. There were some documents I had to return to the dorm right away to receive.
Dantsu, could I ask you to handle that?”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes. Where should I pick it up?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Hah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we tried again and again,
changing locations and situations, but the result remained the same...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry... Um,
as far as I'm concerned, being relied on
isn't something I hate or find bothersome, so... I just couldn't help it.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: If anything, I'm kind of happy...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. I know that already!
That's why I'm telling you to pick who you're dealing with!
You soft-hearted idiot!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haha. Looks like this is still going to take quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seemed that ingrained habits were not so easily changed.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Me? ...Fine by me.
I was the one who brought it up anyway."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Thank you, Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we think up the setting first?
The situation is very important, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're heading to training now, right, Pokke?
Before that, though, could you help me harvest some vegetables?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yes! Leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
W-What!?
You have to say no, Pokke-chan.
You have training!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hah... Oh no...!
That's right, I have training today, so I need to put my foot down and—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, harvesting should serve as good training too.
Could I ask for your help?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I see...! As expected of Fuji-sa... Ah.
N-No, I mean... um...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...! Pocket-chan! Leave this to me!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Dants...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-chan did so much...
all for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: This time, it's my turn... In Pokke-chan's place, I'll—!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
Well then, could I ask you to help with the harvest?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...That's a good response.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It looks like it will still be a long time
before Dantsu Flame learns how to
turn down requests from others."
